result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/ExtendedBufferedReaderAgentTest.java` with 19 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `ExtendedBufferedReader`: both constructors (including byte-tracking with/without charset, multi-byte UTF-8), `read()`/`read(char[],int,int)` including zero-length and EOF-at-start cases, `peek`, `readLine` edge cases (CR/LF/CRLF/blank lines, EOF), `mark`/`reset`, `close` semantics, line-number boundary logic, and position tracking. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
